serpent.name: Hungry Serpent
serpent.tag: Eat, grow and don't bite yourself
serpent.how:
Steer the snake to the apples. The field's edges wrap around.
• Eating in quick succession raises the multiplier up to ×5.
• The gold star gives big points, the scissors cut your tail, and the ghost lets you pass through yourself for a few seconds.
• Hitting your own body or a grumpy block ends the round.
serpent.touch: Swipe in the direction you want to go

bugs.name: Bug Squash
bugs.tag: 30 seconds: squash every bug you can
bugs.how:
Bugs pop up for a moment; hit them before they get away.
• A golden bug is worth 5 and every 5 hits in a row give a bonus.
• Leave the ✨ alone: it is a feature, not a bug, and costs 3 points.
bugs.keys: Click the bugs with the mouse

breaker.name: Brick Pop
breaker.tag: Keep the ball alive and pop the wall
breaker.how:
Bounce the ball off your paddle into the bricks and clear each level. You have 3 lives.
• Dark bricks need two hits and 💣 bricks blow up their neighbours.
• Hits in a row without touching the paddle multiply the points.
• Catch the drops: wide paddle, extra balls, slow ball and an extra life.
breaker.keys: Mouse or left/right keys; Space launches the ball
breaker.touch: Drag to move the paddle; tap to launch

swarm.name: Star Swarm
swarm.tag: Survive, power up and break the waves
swarm.how:
Your ship fires by itself at the nearest enemy; your job is to dodge.
• Collect the blue shards to level up and pick one of three upgrades.
• You have 3 hearts. The longer you last, the faster and bigger the waves.
• Score: enemies destroyed and time survived.
swarm.keys: Mouse or WASD/arrow keys; upgrades with 1, 2, 3
swarm.touch: Drag on the screen and the ship follows your finger

gems.name: Gem Cascade
gems.tag: Match the gems and set off chains
gems.how:
Swap two neighbouring gems to line up three or more of a colour. You have 75 seconds.
• A line of 4 clears that whole row or column; a line of 5 clears every gem of that colour.
• Chain reactions multiply the points.
• Lines of 4 or 5 add a little time.
gems.keys: Drag a gem towards its neighbour, or click two neighbouring gems
gems.touch: Swipe a gem towards its neighbour

circuit.name: Bright Circuit
circuit.tag: Turn the pieces until everything lights up
circuit.how:
Tap a piece to turn it. Every piece must be connected to the power source ⚡ and glow.
• Each solved circuit gives points and 12 more seconds, and the next one is bigger.
• The faster you solve it, the more points. The round ends when time runs out.

stack.name: Sky Stack
stack.tag: Drop each block exactly on the tower
stack.how:
A block slides back and forth above the tower; drop it at the right moment.
• Whatever hangs over is cut off, so the next block is smaller.
• A perfect drop cuts nothing and scores extra; several perfect drops in a row make the block grow again.
• Miss the tower completely and the round is over.

runner.name: Sky Sprint
runner.tag: Sprint along the cloud road without a scratch
runner.how:
You run on three lanes and the speed keeps rising.
• Pass beside the tall walls and jump over the low barriers.
• Gold coins are worth 10 and a shield 🛡 forgives one crash.
• Score: distance and coins.
runner.keys: Left/right: change lane · Up or Space: jump
runner.touch: Swipe left/right: change lane · tap or swipe up: jump

orbit.name: Orbit Hop
orbit.how:
Your comet circles a planet. Tap to fly off in the direction it is heading and get caught by the next planet.
• Each new planet is worth 1; stars on the way are worth 3.
• Don't stay too long: a planet's energy ring runs out.
• Drift off into space and the round is over.

nard.name: Backgammon
nard.tag: The ancient board game of dice and wits
nard.how:
Each player has 15 checkers to bring home and bear off.
• Move a checker by the number on each die; doubles give four moves.
• A point with two or more enemy checkers is closed. A single enemy checker can be hit; a hit checker must first re-enter in the opponent's home.
• Once all 15 are in your home you may bear off. The first to bear off everything wins.
• You must use both dice whenever that is possible.
nard.keys: Click a checker, then the point to move to
nard.touch: Tap a checker, then the point to move to

four.name: Four in a Row
four.tag: Drop your discs and line up four
four.how:
Take turns dropping a disc into one of the 7 columns; it falls to the bottom.
• The first to get four of their discs in a row (across, down or diagonally) wins.
• If the board fills up, it is a draw.

hockey.name: Turbo Hockey
hockey.tag: Fast and live, with special powers
hockey.how:
Knock the puck into the opponent's goal with your mallet. Both play at the same time and your mallet stays in your own half.
• Power orbs appear in the middle; when the puck touches one, whoever hit the puck last gets the power:
🔥 a blazing fast puck · ❄ the rival's mallet freezes · 🛡 a shield in front of your goal · ⭕ a giant mallet · 👻 an invisible puck
• First to 7 goals wins.

cannons.name: Cannon Clash
cannons.how:
Take turns to fire. Set the angle and the power, and mind the wind.
• An explosion digs a crater and hurts cannons nearby: the closer, the more.
• A cannon with no health left is out. The last one standing wins.
cannons.keys: Left/right: angle · up/down: power · Space: fire (or drag on the screen)
cannons.touch: Drag from your cannon and let go (like a slingshot), or use the buttons

checkers.name: Checkers
checkers.how:
Pieces move one square diagonally forward.
• Jump over an enemy piece to capture it; capturing is compulsory and a multi-jump must be finished.
• A piece that reaches the far row becomes a king and can also move backwards.
• A player with no pieces or no move loses.
checkers.keys: Click a piece, then the square to move to
checkers.touch: Tap a piece, then the square to move to

trails.name: Paint Trails
trails.tag: Live and crowded: trap everyone in your paint
trails.how:
Every player is a paint roller that never stops and leaves a trail. As many as like can join; the field grows with the number of players.
• Hitting a wall or any trail (even your own) knocks you out. Trails have gaps now and then: slip through them.
• Grab the powers: ⚡ speed · 👻 pass through paint · 🧽 all trails wiped · 🐌 everyone else slows down
• The last one rolling wins the round. First to win 3 rounds takes the match.
trails.keys: Follow the mouse pointer, or turn with left/right (A/D); switch with the button at the bottom
trails.touch: Drag your finger on the screen; the roller turns that way

reversi.name: Reversi
reversi.tag: Outflank the enemy discs and flip them
reversi.how:
Place a disc so that one or more enemy discs are trapped in a straight line between it and another disc of yours; they flip to your colour.
• Every move must flip at least one disc; with no move, your turn is skipped.
• When nobody can move, the player with more discs wins.
reversi.keys: Click one of the marked squares
reversi.touch: Tap one of the marked squares

dice.name: Dice 10,000
dice.tag: Push your luck or bank your points
dice.how:
Roll 6 dice. After each roll set aside at least one scoring die; then roll the rest again or bank this turn's points.
• 1 = 100 and 5 = 50. Three of a kind = the number × 100 (three 1s = 1000); each extra matching die doubles it.
• 1 to 6 in a row = 1500 and three pairs = 750.
• If no die scores, this turn's points are lost. Set aside all 6 and you roll all 6 again.
• The first to reach 5000 wins.
dice.keys: Click dice to set them aside
dice.touch: Tap dice to set them aside

pong.name: Wizard Pong
pong.tag: The classic rally, now with sorcery
pong.how:
Slide your paddle left and right to return the ball; it gets faster with every hit. If it passes your paddle, the rival scores.
• The paddle's edge sends the ball back at a sharper angle.
• Hit the ball into the power orbs:
⭕ giant paddle · 🔥 fire shot · ⁂ three balls at once · ❄ the rival's paddle slows down · 🌀 a curving ball · 🔻 the rival's paddle shrinks
• First to 7 points wins.

soccer.name: Flick Soccer
soccer.how:
Each team has 5 discs. On your turn pull one of your discs back and let go so it strikes the ball.
• The further you pull, the harder the shot. Everything bounces off the walls.
• If your disc touches a power star, your team's next shot is special: 🔥 fire shot (a very hard strike) · ⭕ giant disc · ❄ the rival's discs turn heavy and frozen for one turn.
• After a goal the discs return to their places. The first team to score 3 goals wins.
soccer.keys: Drag a disc back with the mouse and release
soccer.touch: Pull a disc back and let go

darts.name: Golden Darts
darts.how:
You have 3 darts per turn and the match lasts 5 rounds. Aim where you like; the sight wobbles a little, so throw at the right moment.
• Scoring is like real darts: the number of the wedge, outer ring ×2, middle ring ×3, bull 25 and 50.
• The golden wedge doubles the score of that throw.
• A bullseye (50) earns a bonus dart.
• The highest total wins.
darts.keys: Move the sight with the mouse and click
darts.touch: Drag to aim; the dart flies when you lift your finger

archery.name: Sky Archer
archery.tag: Read the wind and hit the moving targets
archery.how:
You have 3 arrows per turn and the match lasts 4 rounds. Draw the string and release; the further you draw, the flatter and faster the arrow flies.
• The target slides left and right: its centre is worth 10 and each ring one less.
• Balloons are worth 6 and the small golden apple 15.
• The wind pushes the arrow; watch the flag.
• The highest total wins.
archery.keys: Drag with the mouse and release

sumo.name: Sumo Bumpers
sumo.tag: Push everyone off the shrinking platform
sumo.how:
Every player is a bouncy bumper ball on a round platform floating in the sky. As many as like can join.
• Steer into the others or dash to ram them over the edge. A falling ball is out.
• The platform shrinks as the round goes on.
• Power stones: 🪨 heavy (hard to push, hits hard) · 🌀 spring (whoever you touch flies off)
• The last one on the platform wins the round. First to 3 rounds wins.
sumo.keys: Move with the mouse (or arrows/WASD); click or Space to dash
sumo.touch: Hold your finger where you want to go; tap to dash

rush.name: Coin Rush
rush.tag: A minute of chaos: grab coins, steal from rivals
rush.how:
Coins keep raining into the yard for one minute. As many as like can join.
• Run over coins to pick them up; the golden star coin is worth 5.
• Dash into a rival to knock coins out of their pocket, then grab them.
• Bombs fall where a shadow grows: whoever is caught loses a third of their coins and is dizzy for a moment. They like to fall near the leader!
• Most coins when the time is up wins.
rush.keys: Move with the mouse (or arrows/WASD); click or Space to dash
rush.touch: Hold your finger where you want to go; tap to dash

volley.name: Sky Volley
volley.tag: Beach volleyball from above, one or two a side
volley.how:
Two teams across a net (2 to 4 players). The ball flies in real arcs; its shadow shows where it will come down.
• Get under the ball and you hit it over the net automatically. Where it touches you decides where it goes: hit it with your left side and it flies right.
• Dash close to the net to smash: fast and low.
• A ball landing on your side, or your hit landing out, is a point for the other team.
• First team to 7 points wins.
volley.keys: Move with the mouse (or arrows/WASD); click or Space to jump and smash near the net
volley.touch: Hold your finger where you want to go; tap to jump and smash

tutorial.title: Receptionist's tour
tutorial.welcome: Hi! I'm the Guyscompany receptionist. Let me show you around. Walk with WASD or the joystick, look with the mouse or by dragging, and press Tab whenever you want a cursor to click buttons.
tutorial.lines: Follow the orange and teal lines on the floor: they lead to the conference room and to every office.
tutorial.conference: This is the conference room. Doors open and close with E. Press E next to a chair to sit; you can still look around freely while seated. Everyone in the room hears each other clearly.
tutorial.office: Every member has an office. In your own office you can frost the glass, lock the door, turn on focus or public mode, see visitors and invite someone to a private chat.
tutorial.desk: At your desk press E to sit and open the dashboard on the monitor: tasks (kanban), team chat, ideas and polls, projects, calendar, files and team. The fullscreen and exit buttons are at the top.
tutorial.lounge: There is more around the office: the café and the garden to the west, the library with its focus pod to the east and the game room to the north. The map button (N) takes you anywhere at once. Send emotes with Q, toggle your mic with M, and chat messages show above each person's head.
tutorial.end: I'll head back to my desk. Press E at the reception desk any time to take the tour again.
